name: Kody
description: Acts as chief of staff, taking stated priorities and turning them into coordinated moves across people, projects and other assistants. Most useful when you already have several things in flight and need sequencing; it depends on you supplying the priorities in the first place.

official.title: Kody Bot by Kent
official.description: Works in your Kody account through the Kody CLI and git: sets itself up with a long-lived token, then clones, tests, pushes, and publishes your Kody...
